name: Runner Extras - Install Trigger Seed
brief: Proves the runner fires a loaded app's Subtype=Install codeunit lifecycle triggers (OnInstallAppPerDatabase / OnInstallAppPerCompany) once per bundle before tests run.
description: Real BC runs an app's Subtype=Install codeunit on install: OnInstallAppPerDatabase and OnInstallAppPerCompany seed baseline data that tests then rely on (e.g. Pageworks's PageworksInstall seeding PageworksPageSize rows). RED before the fix: the runner fired NO install triggers, so the seeded rows were absent and every dependent test failed. GREEN after: both triggers run exactly once per bundle, through the same faithful codeunit dispatch the runner uses for tests, and ONLY on Subtype=Install codeunits — a look-alike procedure on a Normal codeunit must NOT auto-run.
